events.title: Basil II destroys Tsar Samuel's army at Kleidion
events.description: In the Belasitsa mountains, the Byzantine emperor Basil II outflanked and destroyed the army of Tsar Samuel of Bulgaria. Byzantine chroniclers say Basil had some 15,000 prisoners blinded; Samuel died soon after, and Bulgaria was fully annexed by 1018.

events.title: Count Dirk III defeats an imperial army at Vlaardingen
events.description: Near Vlaardingen, Count Dirk III of West Frisia defeated an imperial army sent by Emperor Henry II to stop him levying tolls on river shipping. The victory laid the foundation of the County of Holland.

events.title: Olaf II of Norway is killed at the Battle of Stiklestad
events.description: At Stiklestad in Trøndelag, King Olaf II of Norway, returning from exile to reclaim his throne, was killed by an army of farmers and chieftains loyal to Cnut the Great. Venerated as Saint Olaf, he became Norway's patron.

events.title: The English fleet defeats the Spanish Armada at Gravelines
events.description: Scattered by fire-ships the night before, the Armada was attacked at close range off Gravelines (29 July Old Style). Driven north by wind, its ships fled around Scotland and Ireland, where many were wrecked.

events.title: The Arc de Triomphe is inaugurated in Paris
events.description: Commissioned by Napoleon in 1806 to honour his armies, the Arc de Triomphe was finally inaugurated under King Louis-Philippe. Since 1921 it has sheltered France's Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

events.title: King Umberto I of Italy is assassinated at Monza
events.description: The anarchist Gaetano Bresci shot Umberto I to avenge the killing of protesters in Milan in 1898. It was one of a wave of anarchist assassinations that also claimed US President McKinley in 1901.

events.title: Eisenhower signs the act creating NASA
events.description: Spurred by Sputnik, President Eisenhower signed the National Aeronautics and Space Act, creating a civilian space agency. NASA opened that October and within 11 years landed astronauts on the Moon.

events.title: Prince Charles marries Lady Diana Spencer
events.description: The Prince of Wales married Lady Diana Spencer at St Paul's Cathedral before a global television audience estimated at 750 million. The couple separated in 1992 and divorced in 1996.
